quest.title: Light Upon the Sea
quest.description: Lantern Rite is still ongoing. With the help of Xiao, Kaeya, and the Millelith, you have foiled a "plot" that has left you not knowing whether to laugh or cry and have succeeded in bringing the foolish criminal behind it to justice and handing them over to the Millelith. Today, you prepare to go to Wangshu Inn to report the results of the matter to Xiao, as you agreed...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

talks.objective: Go back to Wangshu Inn and report back to Xiao

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: So, is the matter resolved?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We took care of it, but—

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: —Good.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you really not going to see the Mingxiao Lantern?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: No. As I said, I am not partial to crowded areas. Especially at this time of the year.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Mingxiao Lantern this year is Skybracer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's a super impressive-looking giant deer, let's go take a look together!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: "Skybracer..."

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Huh, a Mingxiao Lantern nonetheless. A fleeting creation of human hand. It means nothing to me.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: If this short-lived spectacle is one you wish to witness, I suggest you go to the city.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Sounds like you and Xiao took care of business again.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Word certainly got around, the news even reached us here.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: *sigh* And yet, another year's Lantern Rite will soon be over, and he still won't go and take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...All these long years and I've never seen him attend the Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: I'd go as far as to say, it'd be easier bringing the festival to him than the other way around...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bring the festival to him... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nice idea.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! If Xiao won't go to the Lantern Rite, then let's bring the Lantern Rite to him!

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: ...Sorry? Surely you realize I was joking... How would you "bring the Lantern Rite to him," exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When we were in the city checking out the festivities, we learned how to make Xiao Lanterns. We even found a food stall serving local delicacies...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So much tasty food, so many pretty Xiao lanterns, not to mention... um... what else... Oh, the bygone heroes, his old friends.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aren't those the heart and soul of the Lantern Rite?

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: You're not wrong, but where would we set all that up...?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, I wonder... We'd need enough space to set up our own stall. Hmm... There might just be enough room <color=#00E1FFFF>below the inn</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Let's take a look and choose a space. I believe I know the kind of stall you're after...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Hmm, there should be a few styles we can reference, let me think...

talks.objective: Find a good spot for a stall
Continue looking for a suitable spot
Continue looking for a suitable spot

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Here's not too bad... and it's safely away from all the foot traffic. A fitting choice.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: We've got ourselves a nice spot, now we need to build a proper stall. I've thought about it, and I believe I know roughly how to go about it.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: If you'll excuse me for a moment, I'll try to figure out where to start...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: And voila! A little rough around the edges, but it should serve us well. What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think you've missed your true calling! Such expert carpentry...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: It was no big deal! Just a little bit of DIY that I picked up years ago. I've forgotten most of it, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Well, we can check the stall off our to-do list. It looks quite festive decorated with that Xiao Lantern, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know how to make Xiao Lanterns too?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Well yes, but in my generation, it's just the norm for everyone who grew up in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Anyway, speaking of festivities... No celebration is complete without a feast. Do you know what you would like on the menu?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Almond Tofu, that's for sure! We've made it for Xiao before.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And Grilled Tiger Fish.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Almond Tofu and Grilled Tiger Fish, hmm... What an interesting combination of flavors! I'll have a word with Smiley Yanxiao.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: He should be able to rustle those up in no time. Luckily, the inn's pantry contains all the necessary ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Oh, it's about time to summon our honored guest. Could you fetch him? The food should be ready by the time you come down.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: What now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'd like you to come to Lantern Rite with us.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...We've had the talk about crowded places. Do not make me repeat myself. Best you go alone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I didn't say you have to go to Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...What is that supposed to mean?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You wouldn't go to the festival, so we brought the festival to you.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You "brought the festival to me"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so there's a bunch of delicious snacks just laid out below the inn, and a bunch of Xiao lanterns, and there's practically no one else around to have to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's even Almond Tofu and Grilled Tiger Fish...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Better hurry up or the food's gonna go cold. Come on down!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ta-da! Your very own, miniature Lantern Rite festival! Well if it doesn't look mouth-watering...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: So this is what you meant by bringing the festival to me... *sigh* Is there no end to the peculiarities of human behavior?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Does it serve any grander purpose?

choices.text: This way you can take part in Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Is that so? Hmph, human motives defy my attempts to fathom them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Less fathoming, more eating! Come on, dig in, before it gets cold!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmm-mmm, okay, Paimon's gonna concentrate on eating now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh... Now that we're done with the most important part of the celebration, we should be heading out to see the Mingxiao Lantern.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Come with us, Xiao.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: You may take your leave. There's nothing for me over there.

choices.text: You might as well keep us company on the way there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, the Mingxiao Lantern may not be your thing, but... surely, there's no harm in taking a walk with us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The road from here to Liyue Harbor is long and full of dangers... We need someone to ensure our safety!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nobody says you have to enter the city... You can just see us off at the outskirts.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Hmph.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: So be it. I shall accept your proposal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There you go! Alright, time to hit the road!

choices.text: O Vigilant Yaksha, please escort us safely to the city.
Lantern Rite is meant to include everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: There, the stall's really starting to come together now.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, how's the food coming along?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Everything's ready.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Good. Let me start setting it all out then. In the meantime, you can go bring our guest. Hurry along now, we don't want to let our food get cold.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: This is as far as I will go. Please see yourselves into the city.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: What now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You are obviously one of the heroes this festival is all about... Why don't you want to get involved?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I... detest the rabble.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: No cares in the world, so peaceful, so joyful... They are nothing like me.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Too long have I spent slaughtering, accompanied by the burden of suffering that follows in its wake. Crossing paths with all those jubilant people will only make me...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...That's all I have to say.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Farewell.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you sure you don't want to go with us?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Are you really so enamored with such trivial amusements?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do you think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! This is a legitimate festival, not some trivial amusement!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Legitimate...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Enough. Go watch your lanterns.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: But stay vigilant. Keep your eyes open for any menace. If you find yourself in trouble... speak my name.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure you'd make it into the city in time to come to the rescue?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Anywhere. Anytime.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Whether yours or Liyue's, I hear all cries for help, all prayers for peace, and all the wishes carried by the lanterns.

choices.text: (...Never mind, he can see it from here.)

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: If this short-lived spectacle is one you wish to witness, I suggest you go to the city. I, for one, have no interest in the Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Heh, Smiley Yanxiao's no run-of-the-mill chef, huh? Oh, you should visit the city after our meal. You'll just make it in time to see the Mingxiao Lantern being released.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: I can't believe you managed to talk him into dining with us. That's a first! And I've known him for years...
